meta.description: Search NCBI databases through Biopython Bio.Entrez, with field-qualified ESearch, EInfo, ESpell, history-server, and disclosed cross-database-count guidance.
meta.audit_type: final pass: all nine archived logical inputs plus two fresh source-derived inputs
meta.execution_note: 38/38 assertions passed with Python 3.14 and Biopython 1.88; NCBI-dependent inputs were run live on 2026-09-24.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Counts, translations, field lists, database-list coverage, and taxonomy behavior were observed from live NCBI responses; the report does not present them as durable biological conclusions.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill supports database searching and makes no individual diagnostic, treatment, or other clinical claim.

methodological_ground.detail: The final pass corrects the exact-node taxonomy syntax to :noexp and directs users to QueryTranslation and EInfo rather than relying on assumed field behavior.

code_usability.detail: Source-derived examples and extracted fenced blocks executed under Biopython 1.88; no missing dependency or fabricated error-body behavior was observed.

functional_suitability.note: ESearch, EInfo, ESpell, history-server, and cross-database workflows are documented and exercised.

reliability.note: Current Biopython DbInfo shape, EGQuery absence, error-body handling, and exact-node taxonomy behavior are covered by tests.

performance_context.note: Rate limits, retmax, history-server retrieval, and the cost of widening to all databases are explicit; a full 38-database widening run took 27.8 seconds.

agent_usability.note: The 289-line entrypoint routes database-specific fields and recovery details to one focused reference.

human_usability.note: Decision table, examples, limits, and recovery routes are clear and linked.

security.note: Keys are environment-sourced; terms are URL parameters; the preflight helper is explicitly framed as an operational, not security, guard.

maintainability.note: Query and failure detail is isolated in a linked reference, and the new local preflight example is executable without network access.

agent_specific.note: The trigger, decision table, source examples, and reference routing distinguish search, field discovery, and large-result workflows.

inputs.label: PubMed field-qualified search
inputs.note: Source-extracted search_ncbi returned a nonempty translated 2024 query and at most 20 live PMIDs.

inputs.label: EInfo DbInfo list shape
inputs.note: Source-extracted list_fields worked for taxonomy and assembly; live structure and biosample responses were list-of-one DbInfo objects.

inputs.label: History-server queue
inputs.note: A human RefSeq protein query returned 197,927 records with nonempty WebEnv and QueryKey.

inputs.label: MARCH1 ambiguity
inputs.note: The unqualified query returned 703 records while the field-qualified MARCHF1 query returned one.

inputs.label: History chaining and spell check
inputs.note: A same-WebEnv intersection was bounded by both parent counts and ESpell corrected colen carsinoma.

inputs.label: EGQuery fallback
inputs.note: Shipped global_query.py exposed the expected EGQuery AttributeError, counted ten curated databases, and found Gene ID 5728 for human PTEN.

inputs.label: Error-body parsing
inputs.note: Both synthetic XML error bodies raised RuntimeError and a real control response remained parseable.

inputs.label: Widen to live database list
inputs.note: EInfo listed 38 databases; all ten curated names were valid and the widening pattern completed 38/38 with zero errors.

inputs.label: Term URL encoding
inputs.note: Biopython source had no shell/eval path, uses URL encoding, escaped metacharacters, and accepted a live adversarial-looking term without execution.

inputs.label: Query preflight
inputs.note: The shipped helper preserved a normal field-qualified term and rejected empty, overlong, and OR-heavy terms.

inputs.label: Exact-node taxonomy syntax
inputs.note: Live nucleotide counts confirmed :exp preserves Mammalia expansion while :noexp narrows it from 92,281,225 to 113 records.

key_strengths: All nine archived scenario areas and two fresh inputs passed from the committed source.
The entrypoint is 289 lines and routes query-design and failure-recovery detail to a focused reference.
The new preflight helper is runnable, source-tested, and correctly scoped as an operational guard.
Live verification corrected the previously inverted taxonomy exact-node guidance.
